findings.F1: The book's whole gain sits in its few best days. The top 5 % of its days by daily return add 3.53 times the book's total gain, and on those days the book earns +1.81 % while the coins fall 5.96 %. On its worst 5 % of days it loses 1.28 % while the coins rise 5.28 %. The book is a bet on rare sharp falls, paid for by sharp rebounds.
findings.F2: The tested situation does show a short-side move on the shown folds, but it is unstable. On the 5-day grid in falling markets, cases with shrunk 30-day volume and a negative 5-day return have a mean excess 5-day return of -3.50 % (t -2.01, 140 cases, 44 days). The years disagree: -3.99 % in 2018 (t -1.70), -3.83 % in 2019 (t -2.03), +6.15 % in 2020 (6 days) and +0.83 % in 2021. The other three cells of the volume-and-5-day-return split range from +0.46 % to +1.55 %, with every t under 0.6.
findings.F3: In falling markets the grading by 30-day volume shrinkage leans the theory's way but cannot be told from chance. Quartiles from most shrunk to most grown give mean excess 5-day returns of -3.10 % (t -1.58), -0.59 %, +1.11 % and +0.57 %, with 36 to 59 days per quartile.
findings.F4: The planned regime ("trending": falling, dried-up and still sliding) gives -1.91 % (t -1.53, 250 cases, 93 days) on the shown folds. All falling-market grid cases together give +0.04 % (t 0.04, 677 cases). The falling profile alone carries no continuation.

findings.F6: Range, close location, short-term volume (5-day against 20-day) and volatility level give no quintile or tercile in either market with |t| above 1.9. In falling markets, the extreme quintiles of 5-day return and 20-day volume ratio stay under |t| 1.4.

no_ideas: The only pattern with |t| near 2 is the tested idea's own situation (F2, F3), which is unstable across years. Every other angle examined (forecast and regime splits, 1-, 5- and 20-day returns, volume ratios, range, close location, volatility level, weekday, and the book's best and worst days) gave nothing that stands out after this many comparisons (F5, F6). The profile map's empty cells, choppy agitated and falling agitated on the short side, showed no clear short-side pattern either.
